items.exampleCN: 反面名词用了另一个词尾。

definition_zh: 明智的；聪明的；有智慧的；（口语）知晓的；以…方式
definition_en: having or showing good judgement built from experience, and in spoken use, knowing about something
core_image: 一个人抬手示意同伴先别急，等对方把话说完才点头回了一句
scene: 朋友刚要发火，他抬手示意先别急，等对方把话讲完才慢慢点头。It was a wise decision to leave before the storm began.
sceneCN: 这里 wise 是「明智的」（第 1 个义项：判断得当、有分寸）；句意为在风暴来临前离开是明智的决定。抬手示意别急的那一下，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 明智的；有智慧的；（口语）知晓的

senses.title: Judging well from experience
senses.definition: able to see what matters and choose the right way, especially because of long experience
senses.definitionCN: 能看清什么要紧并选对做法，尤其因长期经验而如此
senses.example: It was a wise decision to leave before the storm began.
senses.exampleCN: 在风暴来临前离开是明智的决定。
senses.why: The old adjective simply described someone who knows, and knowing how to act came to be the heart of it.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老形容词最初只形容某人知道，后来懂得如何行动成了它的核心。

senses.title: In spoken use: aware of
senses.definition: in informal speech, knowing about something, often something hidden or unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 在口语中表示知道某事，常指隐藏或不愉快的事
senses.example: She was wise to their tricks and refused to sign.
senses.exampleCN: 她看穿了他们的把戏，拒绝签字。
senses.why: The informal sense keeps the old idea of knowing, but strips away the judgement and leaves mere awareness.
senses.whyCN: 口语义保留了古老「知道」的观念，却剥掉了判断，只剩知晓。

senses.title: As a suffix: in the way of
senses.definition: attached to a noun to mean with regard to that thing, as in money-wise or stepwise
senses.definitionCN: 接在名词后表示就某方面而言或按某种方式，如 money-wise、stepwise
senses.example: Clockwise means turning in the direction of a clock.
senses.exampleCN: clockwise 意为沿钟表指示的方向旋转。
senses.why: A separate suffix -wise came from the same root and means manner, which is why it attaches so freely.
senses.whyCN: 另有一个来自同一词根的后缀 -wise 表示方式，所以它能自由地黏在各种词上。

intro.en: Wise is a Germanic adjective of knowing, Old English wīs, related to the verb that gave wit, and to the noun wisdom.
intro.cn: wise 是日耳曼语中表示「知道」的形容词，古英语 wīs，与产生 wit 的动词同源，也与 wisdom 相关。

items.en: The root meant to see or to know, and the same family gave German wissen, to know.
items.cn: 这个词根意为看见或知道，同族给了德语 wissen（知道）。

items.en: wīs described a person of knowledge and sound counsel, used of rulers and elders.
items.cn: wīs 形容有知识、能给出好建议的人，用于统治者与长者。

items.en: The adjective kept its shape and paired with -dom to name the quality itself.
items.cn: 这个形容词形式未变，与 -dom 结合来命名品质本身。

items.en: The suffix -wise began to mean manner in compound adverbs such as clockwise.
items.cn: 词尾 -wise 开始在 clockwise 这类复合副词中表示方式。

items.en: Spoken English added the lighter sense of simply being aware, as in wise to a trick.
items.cn: 口头英语又添加了仅表示知晓的轻义，如 wise to a trick。

note.en: The first group holds near twins of spelling, the second other adjectives of good judgement.
note.cn: 第一组收拼写相近的词，第二组收其他表示判断良好的形容词。

entries.definition: The noun of the same family.
To go upwards.
A rare spelling variant of wise.
A clever joking remark.
Showing practical good sense.
Careful about the future, avoiding risk.
Showing a lack of sense.

normalIntro.en: Wise is a short word with a long history; link it to wit and wisdom rather than to spelling tricks.
normalIntro.cn: wise 词短史长；把它和 wit、wisdom 连起来，比靠拼写技巧更牢。

normal.en: Wise and wit share a root: both are about knowing.
normal.cn: wise 和 wit 同根：都与「知道」有关。

normal.en: Add dom to get wisdom, the state of being wise.
normal.cn: 加 dom 得到 wisdom，即明智的状态。

normal.en: The past of rise is rose, and rise looks close, but wise needs the z sound.
normal.cn: rise 的过去式是 rose，看起来相近，但 wise 发的是 z 音。

normal.en: Money-wise means where money is concerned: the suffix means with regard to.
normal.cn: money-wise 意为就钱而言：这个后缀表示「就…而言」。

normal.en: A wise choice usually looks boring at the time and obvious years later.
normal.cn: 明智的选择当时看着平淡，多年之后显得理所当然。

abstract.en: A hand raised to slow a friend down.
abstract.cn: 一只抬起的手，让朋友慢一点。

abstract.en: A nod after listening, not during.
abstract.cn: 听完之后的点头，而不是听到一半就点。

abstract.en: A step taken carefully, then a second one.
abstract.cn: 先迈出小心的第一步，再迈第二步。

examples.en: It would be wise to check the figures twice.
examples.cn: 把数字核对两遍是明智的。

examples.en: She gave me some wise advice about saving money.
examples.cn: 她给了我一些关于存钱的明智建议。

examples.en: He is wise to their plan and will not join it.
examples.cn: 他看穿了他们的计划，不会参与。

dict_mnemonic.text: wit（智力）+ -ise 的读音相近 —— 有智力又能用对，就是「明智的」。

root: 日耳曼语词根（看见、知道）→ 古英语 wīs（明智的）→ wise；同族有 wisdom、wisely、wit。

sensesIntro.en: From the deep judgement of the old, the word lightens in speech to mere awareness, and lives on as a suffix meaning in the manner of.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从长者的深厚判断，在口语里变轻为单纯知晓，并作为表示方式的后缀继续存在。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised hand that asks for a moment of thought.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只抬起、要求稍作思考的手。

branches.en: The judgement branch: leaving before the storm.
branches.cn: 判断分支：风暴前动身。

branches.en: The awareness branch: wise to a trick.
branches.cn: 知晓分支：看穿一个把戏。

branches.en: The suffix branch: clockwise, money-wise.
branches.cn: 后缀分支：clockwise、money-wise。

branches.en: The lightness branch: knowing without judging.
branches.cn: 轻义分支：知道而不评判。

branches.en: The practical branch: sense turned into a way of doing things.
branches.cn: 务实分支：判断力化为做事的方式。

intro.en: Wise stands alone and also works as a suffix meaning manner; with -dom and -ly it builds the rest of its family.
intro.cn: wise 可以单独使用，也能当表示方式的后缀；配上 -dom 与 -ly 便构成它的其余家族。

latinIntro.en: The adjective is Germanic; the Latin entries give borrowed words for the same virtue.
latinIntro.cn: 这个形容词属于日耳曼语；拉丁条目给出表达同一美德的借入词。

items.example: The adjective turned into an action.
The wit sense pressed into a joke.
items.exampleCN: 机智义被压进一个笑话。

items.example: The ending marks degrees of judgement.

definition_zh: 希望；愿望；想要；祝愿；许愿
definition_en: to want something to happen, especially something you cannot control, and to express that want
core_image: 生日蛋糕上那点烛火面前，一个人闭眼低头，把愿望在心里说了一遍
scene: 蛋糕上的烛光照到脸上，他闭眼低头，把愿望在心里说了一遍才吹熄。I wish you good luck in the exam tomorrow.
sceneCN: 这里 wish 是「希望、祝愿」（第 1 个义项：希望某事发生、尤其是自己无法掌控的事）；句意为祝你明天考试顺利。闭眼低头许愿的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: To want it to be so
senses.definition: to want something to be true or to happen, especially when you cannot make it happen
senses.definitionCN: 希望某事为真或发生，尤其在自己无法使之实现时
senses.example: I wish you good luck in the exam tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 祝你明天考试顺利。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply to desire, and the word keeps a soft and slightly helpless colour.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是想，这个词保留着温和而略带无力的色彩。

senses.title: To express a hope for someone
senses.definition: to say that you hope someone will be happy, safe or successful, as in good wishes
senses.definitionCN: 说希望某人幸福、平安或成功，如 good wishes
senses.example: She wished the bride and groom a long and happy life.
senses.exampleCN: 她祝愿新郎新娘百年好合。
senses.why: Desire aimed at another person becomes a blessing, which is why the word greets and closes letters.
senses.whyCN: 指向他人的愿望成了祝福，所以这个词能用来问候与收尾信件。

senses.title: A longing in the mind
senses.definition: a strong desire for something, often secret, kept as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 对某物的强烈想望，常是秘密的，作名词使用
senses.example: The old man's last wish was to see the sea again.
senses.exampleCN: 老人最后的愿望是再见一次海。
senses.why: The noun simply names the desire that the verb performs, often before it is spoken aloud.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接命名动词所做的那份欲望，往往在说出口之前就有。

senses.title: To greet with a formula
senses.definition: used in set phrases such as wish you well, to offer a polite and warm formula
senses.definitionCN: 在 wish you well 等固定说法中，用来致以礼貌而温暖的问候
senses.example: The staff wished every guest good morning at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 员工在门口向每位客人问早安。
senses.why: Greetings in most languages are blessings, so wishing is how many conversations begin.
senses.whyCN: 多数语言里的问候都是祝福，所以祝愿是许多对话的开头。

intro.en: Wish is Old English wyscan, to desire, a native Germanic verb that also gave the noun wish, an inner want.
intro.cn: wish 是古英语 wyscan（渴望），一个本土日耳曼语动词，也产生了名词 wish，指内心的想望。

items.en: wyscan meant to long for, often in prayer, and expressed a hope rather than a plan.
items.cn: wyscan 意为渴望，常用于祈祷，表达的是希望而非计划。

items.en: The verb was strong, and its noun form named the desire itself.
items.cn: 这个动词是强变化动词，其名词形式命名欲望本身。

items.en: Spelling settled as wish, and the meaning widened to polite good wishes.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 wish，词义扩展到礼貌的祝愿。

items.en: I wish plus a past form became a fixed way to speak of an unreal state.
items.cn: I wish 加过去式成了谈论不真实状况的固定说法。

items.en: The birthday wish and the wishing well kept the fairy tale sense alive in daily life.
items.cn: 生日愿望与许愿井让童话式的义项在日常生活中存活下来。

note.en: The first group collects look-alikes with similar spelling, the second verbs of wanting and hoping.
note.cn: 第一组收拼写相近的词，第二组收表示想要与希望的动词。

entries.definition: To clean with water.
An animal that lives in water.
Based on wanting rather than on fact.
The power to think and be clever.
To want something with some expectation.
A strong feeling of wanting.
To feel a strong pull towards something absent.

normalIntro.en: Wish is small and soft, best remembered by the picture of a candle and a closed pair of eyes.
normalIntro.cn: wish 短而柔和，最值得记的是那幅烛光与闭眼画面。

normal.en: Wish and fish differ in one letter: you can wish for a fish.
normal.cn: wish 与 fish 只差一个字母：你可以许愿得到一条鱼。

normal.en: Drop the last letter of wash and add i to get wish.
normal.cn: wash 去掉末字母、换上 i，就得到 wish。

normal.en: The third person is wishes, with -es after the sh sound.
normal.cn: 第三人称是 wishes，在 sh 音后加 -es。

normal.en: I wish I knew is not about the past: it is a wish for now.
normal.cn: I wish I knew 说的不是过去，而是此刻的愿望。

normal.en: Wishful thinking is desire dressed as a plan.
normal.cn: wishful thinking 是披着计划外衣的欲望。

abstract.en: One small flame taking the shape of a breath.
abstract.cn: 一小团火焰被一口气吹成的形状。

abstract.en: Eyes closed while the room waits.
abstract.cn: 闭上的眼睛，满屋的人在等。

abstract.en: A coin falling into a well, and no sound coming back.
abstract.cn: 一枚硬币落进井里，没有声音回来。

examples.en: I wish I could stay longer.
examples.cn: 我希望自己能再多待一会儿。

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
examples.cn: 闭上眼睛许个愿吧。

examples.en: We wish you a safe journey home.
examples.cn: 祝你平安回家。

dict_mnemonic.text: wish 与 fish 只差首字母 —— 生日时对着一根蜡烛「许愿」。

root: 古英语 wyscan（渴望、祈祷）→ 中古英语 wischen → wish；同族有 wishful、well-wisher。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as a soft longing, then becomes a blessing for another person, a secret wish kept inside, and finally a polite formula at the door.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从柔和的渴望开始，变成对他人的祝福，再成为藏在心里的愿望，最后成了门口的一句问候。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a candle flame bending in a breath.
core.cn: 核心意象：烛焰被一口气吹弯。

branches.en: The hoping branch: wishing a friend luck in an exam.
branches.cn: 希望分支：祝朋友考试顺利。

branches.en: The blessing branch: wishes for the bride and groom.
branches.cn: 祝福分支：给新郎新娘的祝愿。

branches.en: The longing branch: an old man's last wish.
branches.cn: 渴望分支：老人最后的愿望。

branches.en: The greeting branch: good morning said at the door.
branches.cn: 问候分支：门口的道早。

branches.en: The gap branch: what you wish is often out of reach.
branches.cn: 落差分支：所想望的往往够不到。

intro.en: Wish takes ordinary verb endings and builds a small family: wishful, well-wisher and the wishing well.
intro.cn: wish 能接普通动词词尾，构成一小族词：wishful、well-wisher 和 wishing well。

latinIntro.en: The verb is Germanic; the Latin entries are borrowed words for desire and goodwill.
latinIntro.cn: 这个动词属于日耳曼语；拉丁条目是表示欲望与善意的借入词。

items.example: It is the plain verb and noun.

items.meaning: a well where wishes are made
items.example: The old picture kept in a place.
items.exampleCN: 古老画面藏进一处地方。

items.example: The noun used to close a letter.

definition_zh: 智力；机智；风趣；头脑；才子
definition_en: the power of thinking quickly and cleverly, and the ability to say amusing things
core_image: 对话里一句轻巧的反击落下，满桌人愣了一秒才同时笑出来
scene: 有人不客气地挑刺，他只用一句轻巧的反话回了过去，满桌人愣了一秒才笑出来。Her wit made even boring meetings feel short.
sceneCN: 这里 wit 是「机智、风趣」（第 1 个义项：迅速而巧妙的思考与表达能力）；句意为她的风趣让连无聊的会议都觉得短。那句轻巧反击落下后全桌的笑声，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: The power to think fast
senses.definition: the ability to think quickly and clearly, especially under pressure
senses.definitionCN: 迅速而清晰地思考的能力，尤其在压力之下
senses.example: He had the wit to see that the door was a trap.
senses.exampleCN: 他脑子够快，看出那扇门是个陷阱。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the mind itself, the seat of thought and sense.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是心智本身，是思想与知觉的所在。

senses.title: Clever and amusing speech
senses.definition: the talent for saying things that are clever and funny at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 把聪明与好笑合在一句话里的才能
senses.example: Her wit made even boring meetings feel short.
senses.exampleCN: 她的风趣让连无聊的会议都觉得短。
senses.why: When the quick mind comes out as speech, the same noun names the sparkle it produces.
senses.whyCN: 当敏捷的心变成言语，同一个名词就命名了它迸出的火花。

senses.title: A person of such talent
senses.definition: a clever and amusing person, used in older literary style
senses.definitionCN: 聪明而有风趣的人，多见于较旧的文体
senses.example: The party was full of wits and would-be poets.
senses.exampleCN: 聚会上满是有机锋的人和自封的诗人。
senses.why: The quality was used to name the people who carry it, a habit common in older English.
senses.whyCN: 这种品质被用来命名拥有它的人，这是老式英语中常见的习惯。

intro.en: Wit is Old English witt, the mind or understanding, from the same root as the verb witan, to know, which also gave wise.
intro.cn: wit 是古英语 witt（心智、理解），与动词 witan（知道）同根，而 wise 也出自这一族。

items.en: witt meant the mind and its power to understand, used in the plural for the senses.
items.cn: witt 指心智及其理解力，复数形式指五种感官。

items.en: The verb witan, to know, was one of the oldest and commonest verbs of thought.
items.cn: 动词 witan（知道）是最古老、最常见的思维动词之一。

items.en: The word moved from general mind to quick intelligence and to clever speech.
items.cn: 这个词从泛指的头脑移向敏捷的智力，再移向机智的言语。

items.en: The age of coffee houses and essays made wit the mark of a good talker.
items.cn: 咖啡馆与随笔的时代让 wit 成了健谈者的标志。

items.en: Wits keep the older sense of alertness, as in keeping your wits about you.
items.cn: 复数 wits 保留了警觉的旧义，如 keeping your wits about you。

note.en: The first group gathers words that resemble wit, the second other names for intelligence and humour.
note.cn: 第一组收与 wit 形近的词，第二组收表示智力与幽默的其他词。

entries.definition: To want something to happen.
Together, or by means of.
Clever and funny in speech.
The mind's alertness, in the plural.
The quality of being funny.
The power to learn and reason.
Lack of sense or quickness.

normalIntro.en: Wit is only three letters but holds two ideas: the mind and the joke it makes.
normalIntro.cn: wit 只有三个字母，却装了两个意思：头脑，和头脑开的玩笑。

normal.en: Put an h after w and you get whit, meaning a tiny bit, not the same word.
normal.cn: 在 w 后加 h 得到 whit，意为一点点，不是同一个词。

normal.en: Wit plus the -y ending gives witty: full of wit.
normal.cn: wit 加词尾 -y 得到 witty：满是机智。

normal.en: At your wits end is the picture of an empty box being shaken.
normal.cn: at your wits end 是一个空盒子被摇晃的画面。

normal.en: Wise and wit come from the same family: both are about knowing.
normal.cn: wise 与 wit 同族：都与知道有关。

normal.en: Outwit puts the smart one ahead of the other.
normal.cn: outwit 把聪明的那一方放到对方前面。

abstract.en: A short sentence, a half-second of silence, then laughter.
abstract.cn: 一句短话，半秒安静，然后是笑声。

abstract.en: A knife so thin that nobody feels it land.
abstract.cn: 一把薄刃，落下时没人察觉。

abstract.en: Two people looking at each other and both understanding at once.
abstract.cn: 两个人对视，同时明白。

examples.en: The old woman kept her wit sharp to the end.
examples.cn: 那位老妇人到晚年头脑依然敏锐。

examples.en: His reply showed real wit, and the room relaxed.
examples.cn: 他的回答显出真正的机智，屋里气氛一下松了。

examples.en: She was at her wits end with the leaking roof.
examples.cn: 面对漏水的屋顶，她已束手无策。

dict_mnemonic.text: wit 与 wise 同根，都表示「知道、明白」—— 脑子快的人，话也俏。

root: 古英语 witan（知道）→ witt（心智）→ 中古英语 wit；同族有 witty、outwit、wise。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as the mind itself, then becomes the sparkle of clever speech, and finally names the person who talks that way.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从心智本身开始，成为聪明话语的火花，最后命名那样说话的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a short reply followed by a whole table laughing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句短话之后，整桌人的笑。

branches.en: The mind branch: seeing that a door is a trap.
branches.cn: 心智分支：看出一扇门是陷阱。

branches.en: The speech branch: a meeting made short by humour.
branches.cn: 言语分支：被幽默缩短的会议。

branches.en: The person branch: a room full of wits.
branches.cn: 人物分支：满屋的才子。

branches.en: The spark branch: thought turning into a joke.
branches.cn: 火花分支：思考转成一个笑话。

branches.en: The portrait branch: a wit is someone whose talk is expected to amuse.
branches.cn: 画像分支：才子就是那个说话该让人发笑的人。

intro.en: Wit takes a few short endings and builds witty, witless and outwit; the plural wits is a noun of its own.
intro.cn: wit 接几个短词尾，构成 witty、witless、outwit；复数 wits 则是一个独立的名词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, so the Latin entries are borrowed words for intelligence and cleverness.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根属于日耳曼语，所以拉丁条目是表示智力与机智的借入词。

items.example: The root turned into a mild insult.
items.exampleCN: 词根变成温和的骂人话。

definition_zh: 与…一起；用；带着；随着；对…（表示态度）；由于
definition_en: a very common preposition meaning together with, by means of, having, or in relation to
core_image: 两个人的手同时落在一根扁担上，从两头一起把重物抬起来
scene: 两人把扁担搭上肩，一前一后同时起步，步子慢慢就合上了。He came to the meeting with his father and a folder of papers.
sceneCN: 这里 with 是「与…一起」（第 1 个义项：表示伴随、同在）；句意为他带着父亲和一只文件夹来开会。两个人同时握住扁担抬起重物的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 与…一起；用；带着；随着；对…；由于

senses.title: In company of
senses.definition: in the company of a person or an object, or carrying something
senses.definitionCN: 与某人或某物同在，或随身带着某物
senses.example: He came to the meeting with his father and a folder of papers.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着父亲和一只文件夹来开会。
senses.why: The oldest use simply puts two things in one place, side by side at the same moment.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的用法只是把两样东西放在同一处、同一时刻并列。

senses.title: By means of a tool
senses.definition: showing the tool, material or method that does a job
senses.definitionCN: 表示完成某事的工具、材料或方法
senses.example: She cut the bread with a long knife.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一把长刀切面包。
senses.why: The thing in your hand is the closest companion of the act, so company became instrument.
senses.whyCN: 手里握着的东西是动作最近的同伴，于是同伴变成了工具。

senses.title: Attitude towards someone
senses.definition: showing how a person feels about someone, as in angry with or pleased with
senses.definitionCN: 表示某人对某人的感受，如 angry with、pleased with
senses.example: The teacher was pleased with the whole class.
senses.exampleCN: 老师对全班都很满意。
senses.why: Feelings are directed at people who are near, so the company sense turned into a sense of attitude.
senses.whyCN: 情感朝向近旁的人，于是相伴义变成了态度义。

senses.title: Changing together with
senses.definition: showing that two things change at the same time, as in with age or with time
senses.definitionCN: 表示两件事同时变化，如 with age、with time
senses.example: The colours of the leaves change with the season.
senses.exampleCN: 叶子的颜色随季节改变。
senses.why: Two events in step are also two things together, so the word covers parallel change.
senses.whyCN: 同步发生的两件事也是同在的两件事，于是这个词也覆盖并行变化。

intro.en: With is Old English wið, which first meant against, towards, or in exchange for, before it settled into together with.
intro.cn: with 是古英语 wið，最初意为对着、朝向或以物易物，后来才固定为「与…一起」。

items.en: A common Germanic preposition named the idea of being opposite or facing something.
items.cn: 一个共同的日耳曼语介词表示相对、面对某物的观念。

items.en: wið meant against, towards or in exchange for, and often marked opposition.
items.cn: wið 意为对着、朝向或以物换物，常标记对立。

items.en: The same word was used of a meeting between two parties, which carried the seed of togetherness.
items.cn: 同一个词也用于两方相遇，其中埋下了「同在」的种子。

items.en: The sense shifted from opposition to company, and wið became with.
items.cn: 词义从对立转向相伴，wið 变成 with。

items.en: The preposition widened to tools, possession, attitude and simultaneous change.
items.cn: 这个介词扩展到工具、拥有、态度与同步变化。

note.en: The first group collects prepositions built from the same stem, the second near synonyms of company and means.
note.cn: 第一组收由同一词干构成的介词，第二组收表示伴随与手段的近义词。

entries.definition: Inside a place or a period.
Not having, not accompanied by.
The power of clever thinking.
The measure from side to side.
Next to and together with.
Near, or by means of.
The negative of with.

normalIntro.en: With is a function word, so learn it as a set of frames rather than a single meaning.
normalIntro.cn: with 是功能词，把它当成一组句式框架来学，比记单一意思更有效。

normal.en: The th sound is soft and voiced, the same as in this and that.
normal.cn: 它的 th 是浊音，与 this、that 相同。

normal.en: With begins with wit minus the t: a preposition with no jokes inside.
normal.cn: with 就是 wit 去掉 t：一个没有玩笑的介词。

normal.en: Add out to make without, the opposite of company.
normal.cn: 加 out 得到 without，是相伴的反面。

normal.en: Add in to make within, the opposite of crossing a boundary.
normal.cn: 加 in 得到 within，是不越界的说法。

normal.en: With is often a tool, a companion, or a mood, so ask which of the three a sentence needs.
normal.cn: with 常表示工具、同伴或情绪，读到句子先问是哪一种。

abstract.en: Two hands on one pole, lifting at the same moment.
abstract.cn: 两只手在同一根扁担上，同时用力。

abstract.en: Two sets of footprints walking in the same line.
abstract.cn: 两串脚印走在同一条线上。

abstract.en: A hand holding a key that fits a lock.
abstract.cn: 一只手握着正好合锁的钥匙。

examples.en: I went to the market with my aunt.
examples.cn: 我和姑妈一起去了市场。

examples.en: He opened the box with a small screwdriver.
examples.cn: 他用一把小螺丝刀打开了盒子。

examples.en: The room grew quiet with the falling snow.
examples.cn: 随着雪落，房间安静下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: with 三张脸：一起、用、带着 —— 同伴、工具、随身的物。

root: 古英语 wið（对着、朝向、交换）→ 中古英语 with（与…一起）；同族有 within、without、withdraw。

sensesIntro.en: The preposition begins as opposition, turns into company, and spreads from people to tools, attitudes and simultaneous change.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个介词从对立开始，转为相伴，再从人扩展到工具、态度与同步变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands on one carrying pole, lifted at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手在同一根扁担上同时发力。

branches.en: The company branch: arriving with a father and papers.
branches.cn: 相伴分支：带着父亲和文件到场。

branches.en: The tool branch: bread cut by a long knife.
branches.cn: 工具分支：一把长刀切面包。

branches.en: The feeling branch: a teacher pleased with a class.
branches.cn: 情感分支：一个满意的老师。

branches.en: The change branch: leaves turning with the season.
branches.cn: 变化分支：随季节变色的叶子。

branches.en: The nearness branch: what is at hand becomes the means.
branches.cn: 邻近分支：手边之物成了手段。

intro.en: With is a bare preposition that joins other words as a prefix in within, without, withdraw and withhold.
intro.cn: with 是光秃的介词，作为前缀与其他词结合成 within、without、withdraw、withhold。

latinIntro.en: The word is native Germanic, so the Latin entries are borrowed prepositions for the same ideas.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是本土日耳曼语，所以拉丁条目是表达同类观念的借入介词。

items.example: It appears in withdraw and withhold.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 withdraw 与 withhold 中。

definition_zh: 撤走；撤回；退出；取（款）；（从活动中）抽身
definition_en: to pull something back or take it out, and to remove oneself from a place, a plan or an activity
core_image: 一只手伸向桌上的文件，忽然停住，又把它抽回到自己身边
scene: 话才说到一半，他伸手想把文件推回去，手指在纸角上停了一下，又慢慢抽了回来。She withdrew her application at the last minute.
sceneCN: 这里 withdraw 是「撤回、收回」（第 1 个义项：把已经拿出或提出的东西抽回来）；句意为她在最后一刻撤回了申请。手指在纸角上停一下又抽回来的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: To take money out
senses.definition: to take money out of a bank account or a machine
senses.definitionCN: 从银行账户或取款机中取出钱
senses.example: He withdrew two hundred yuan to pay the driver.
senses.exampleCN: 他取了二百元付给司机。
senses.why: The verb pulls something from where it was kept, and money in an account is simply a thing kept somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词把东西从它被存放的地方拉出来，账户里的钱也只是存放在某处的东西。

senses.title: To take back a statement or offer
senses.definition: to say that something you offered or said is no longer in force
senses.definitionCN: 声明自己提出或说过的事不再有效
senses.example: She withdrew her application at the last minute.
senses.exampleCN: 她在最后一刻撤回了申请。
senses.why: Once a word or a paper has been handed over, pulling it back means putting it out of play.
senses.whyCN: 一旦话或文件交了出去，把它拉回来就意味着作废。

senses.title: To leave a place or activity
senses.definition: to remove troops or oneself from a place, a contest or an organisation
senses.definitionCN: 把军队或自己从某地、某场比赛或某组织中撤出
senses.example: The team withdrew from the competition after two injuries.
senses.exampleCN: 两人受伤之后，这支队伍退出了比赛。
senses.why: The physical picture of pulling back became a public act of leaving a stage.
senses.whyCN: 往回拉的身体画面，成了退出舞台的公开行为。

senses.title: To pull away into oneself
senses.definition: to become quiet and avoid other people, often because of worry or hurt
senses.definitionCN: 变得沉默、回避他人，常因忧虑或受伤
senses.example: After the quarrel he withdrew into his own room for days.
senses.exampleCN: 争吵之后他躲进自己的房间里好些天。
senses.why: The same motion turned inward describes a person drawing back from company.
senses.whyCN: 同样的动作转向内心，就形容一个人从人群中退回去。

intro.en: Withdraw is a native compound: the old prefix with-, meaning away or back, joined to draw, to pull.
intro.cn: withdraw 是本土复合词：古前缀 with-（离开、往回）加上 draw（拉）。

items.en: wið meant against or away, and dragan meant to draw or pull, so the pair named pulling back.
items.cn: wið 意为对着或离开，dragan 意为拉，两者合起来就是往回拉。

items.en: Early uses described drawing back a hand, an arrow or a knife.
items.cn: 早期用法描述把手、箭或刀抽回来。

items.en: The compound widened to pulling troops back from a place.
items.cn: 复合词扩展到把军队从某地撤回。

items.en: Banking gave the everyday sense of taking money out of an account.
items.cn: 银行业给了它从账户取钱这一日常义项。

items.en: Modern use adds leaving a competition and drawing away from people emotionally.
items.cn: 现代用法又加上了退出比赛与情感上疏远他人。

note.en: The first group collects members of the with- family and look-alikes, the second verbs of taking back or leaving.
note.cn: 第一组收 with- 家族成员与形近词，第二组收表示收回或离开的动词。

entries.definition: The noun of taking back or out.
To refuse to give something due.
To resist and bear pressure.
The past form of the verb.
To move back from an enemy or a difficulty.
Formally to take back a statement.
To put money into an account.

normalIntro.en: Withdraw splits neatly into with and draw, so the picture is simply drawing something back.
normalIntro.cn: withdraw 干净地分成 with 与 draw 两半，画面就是往回拉东西。

normal.en: With plus draw: draw back what you once put out.
normal.cn: with 加 draw：把曾经伸出去的东西拉回来。

normal.en: The past tense is withdrew, with the same vowel change as drew.
normal.cn: 过去式 withdrew，元音变化与 drew 一致。

normal.en: The past participle withdrawn ends like known and shown.
normal.cn: 过去分词 withdrawn 的结尾像 known、shown。

normal.en: Take out money or take back a promise: both are pulling, one from a box and one from a mouth.
normal.cn: 取钱与收回承诺都是拉：一个从箱子里，一个从嘴里。

normal.en: Withhold only holds, so it refuses; withdraw pulls, so it removes.
normal.cn: withhold 只是握住，所以是拒绝给；withdraw 是拉，所以是拿掉。

abstract.en: A hand hesitating over the corner of a paper.
abstract.cn: 一只手在纸角上方犹豫。

abstract.en: A crowd thinning at the edge of the field.
abstract.cn: 场地边缘渐渐稀疏的人群。

abstract.en: A door closing quietly from the inside.
abstract.cn: 一扇从里面轻轻关上的门。

examples.en: The bank charges a fee to withdraw cash abroad.
examples.cn: 在国外取现银行会收手续费。

examples.en: They withdrew the product after a safety warning.
examples.cn: 一则安全警告之后，他们撤下这款产品。

examples.en: Several countries withdrew from the talks.
examples.cn: 有几个国家退出了谈判。

dict_mnemonic.text: with（往回）+ draw（拉）—— 往回拉，就是「撤回、取款」。

root: 古英语 wið（离开、对着）+ dragan（拉）→ withdraw；同族有 withdrawal、withhold、withstand。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as pulling a thing back, then takes money from an account, a promise from circulation, and a person from a stage or from company.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从往回拉开始，接着从账户取钱、让承诺作废，再把人从舞台或人群中撤回。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pulling a document back towards the chest.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把文件拉回胸前。

chain: TO TAKE OUT WHAT WAS KEPT
THE PAST PARTICIPLE AS AN ADJECTIVE

branches.en: The money branch: cash taken out for a taxi.
branches.cn: 金钱分支：取出现金付车钱。

branches.en: The promise branch: an application pulled back.
branches.cn: 承诺分支：被撤回的申请。

branches.en: The public branch: a team leaving a competition.
branches.cn: 公共分支：退出比赛的队伍。

branches.en: The private branch: days spent alone in a room.
branches.cn: 私人分支：独自待在房里的几天。

branches.en: The inward branch: the same pull, now aimed at oneself.
branches.cn: 内向分支：同一个拉的动作，如今朝向自己。

intro.en: Withdraw takes the old prefix with- and the root draw, then adds -al to make the noun withdrawal.
intro.cn: withdraw 由古前缀 with- 与词根 draw 组成，再加 -al 得到名词 withdrawal。

latinIntro.en: Both parts are Germanic; the Latin entries below are borrowed cousins for the idea of pulling back.
latinIntro.cn: 两部分都属于日耳曼语；下面的拉丁条目只是表示「拉回」的借入表亲。

items.example: It gives the direction of the pulling.

items.exampleCN: 这里前缀是对抗的意思。

items.meaning: the past action of drawing back
in the act of pulling back

definition_zh: 撤回；退出；取款；戒断（症状）；退缩
definition_en: the act of taking something back or out, of leaving a group, or of stopping a habit
core_image: 银行柜员把一叠现金数好，用橡皮筋一扎，从窗口那侧推到你面前
scene: 柜员把一叠现金数好扎紧，从窗口那侧推过来，纸上盖着取款日期。The withdrawal of the offer left the whole team without a plan.
sceneCN: 这里 withdrawal 是「取款、撤回」（第 1 个义项：把钱或已提出之物拿回来这一行为）；句意为提议被撤回，整个团队一下子没了方案。柜员推过来的那叠现金，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: Taking money out
senses.definition: the act of taking money out of a bank account
senses.definitionCN: 从银行账户中把钱取出的行为
senses.example: The withdrawal appeared on her statement the next morning.
senses.exampleCN: 第二天早上，这笔取款就出现在她的账单上。
senses.why: The ending -al turns the verb into the act itself, so withdrawal is the pulling-out as a named event.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -al 把动词变成行为本身，所以 withdrawal 成了有名字的事件。

senses.title: Taking back an offer or support
senses.definition: the act of officially ending an offer, a promise or help you had given
senses.definitionCN: 正式结束自己曾给出的提议、承诺或帮助的行为
senses.example: The withdrawal of the offer left the whole team without a plan.
senses.exampleCN: 提议被撤回，整个团队一下子没了方案。
senses.why: What was given is pulled back, and the noun records that formal pulling back.
senses.whyCN: 所给予的被拉回，名词记录下这次正式的拉回。

senses.title: Leaving a contest or a group
senses.definition: the act of stopping your part in a competition, a treaty or an organisation
senses.definitionCN: 停止参与比赛、条约或组织的行为
senses.example: Its withdrawal from the agreement surprised its allies.
senses.exampleCN: 它退出协议让盟友们大为惊讶。
senses.why: Leaving is the same motion seen from outside: a side folds up and moves away.
senses.whyCN: 离开是同一动作从外部看到的样子：一方收起自己、走开。

senses.title: Stopping a habit
senses.definition: the process and the uncomfortable effects of stopping a substance your body is used to
senses.definitionCN: 停止使用身体已习惯之物时的过程及其不适反应
senses.example: He suffered headaches during the first days of withdrawal.
senses.exampleCN: 戒断的最初几天，他头痛得厉害。
senses.why: The body has grown used to a substance, and taking it away is literally a withdrawal from the body.
senses.whyCN: 身体已习惯了某种物质，把它拿走，字面上就是从身体里抽走。

intro.en: Withdrawal is withdraw plus the Latin-derived noun ending -al, which English borrowed for naming acts.
intro.cn: withdrawal 是 withdraw 加上源自拉丁语的 -al 词尾，英语借它来命名行为。

items.en: The verb was built from wið, away, and dragan, to pull.
items.cn: 这个动词由 wið（离开）与 dragan（拉）构成。

items.en: The verb spread from hands and weapons to promises and troops.
items.cn: 动词从手与武器扩展到承诺与军队。

items.en: The ending -al, borrowed through French, allowed the act to be named as a noun.
items.cn: 经由法语借来的词尾 -al，让这一行为能被命名成名词。

items.en: Banking made the money sense the commonest in daily life.
items.cn: 银行业让取款义成为日常生活中最常见的一个。

items.en: Medicine added the sense of stopping a drug, which spread into general speech.
items.cn: 医学又添加了戒药义，并扩展到日常语言。

note.en: The first group holds the verb and its neighbours, the second other nouns for leaving or taking back.
note.cn: 第一组收动词及其近邻，第二组收表示离开或收回的其他名词。

entries.definition: The verb behind the noun.
Keeping something back from a person.
The act of reaching a place.
The act of agreeing formally.
A movement back from danger.
Formally stepping down from a post.
Money paid into an account.

normalIntro.en: Withdrawal is the verb plus -al, exactly like arrival from arrive and approval from approve.
normalIntro.cn: withdrawal 就是动词加 -al，正如 arrive 变 arrival、approve 变 approval。

normal.en: Withdraw plus al, and the double r stays before the ending.
normal.cn: withdraw 加 al，末尾的 w 与元音之间保留一个 r。

normal.en: Same pattern as arrival and proposal: verbs turn into acts with -al.
normal.cn: 和 arrival、proposal 同一模式：动词加 -al 变成行为。

normal.en: Withdrawal symptoms put the body in a room it has just left.
normal.cn: 戒断症状让身体留在刚离开的那个房间里。

normal.en: Cash withdrawal is the phrase on every cash machine.
normal.cn: cash withdrawal 是每台取款机上都有的字样。

normal.en: Compare withhold and withdraw: one keeps, one pulls back.
normal.cn: 比较 withhold 与 withdraw：一个留住，一个拉回。

abstract.en: A stack of notes pushed through a slot.
abstract.cn: 一叠钞票被从窗口推出来。

abstract.en: A name crossed off a list of talks.
abstract.cn: 谈判名单上的一个名字被划掉。

abstract.en: An empty cup where there was always one before.
abstract.cn: 原本总有杯子在的地方，如今空了。

examples.en: There is a daily limit on cash withdrawals.
examples.cn: 取现每天有额度上限。

examples.en: The withdrawal of the team from the league was announced on Monday.
examples.cn: 球队退出联赛的消息在周一公布。

examples.en: Patience is needed during the withdrawal period.
examples.cn: 戒断期间需要耐心。

dict_mnemonic.text: withdraw（撤回、取款）+ al（行为）—— 这个行为就叫「撤回、取款」。

root: with（离开）+ draw（拉）→ withdraw → withdraw + -al → withdrawal；同族有 withdrawn、withhold。

sensesIntro.en: A single act of pulling back appears as money from an account, an offer from the table, a group from a treaty, and a substance from a body.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个拉回的动作，表现为账户里的钱、桌上的提议、条约里的成员，以及身体里的药物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bundle of notes pushed across a counter.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠钞票从柜台那侧推过来。

branches.en: The money branch: a line on the monthly statement.
branches.cn: 金钱分支：月账单上的一行。

branches.en: The offer branch: a team left without a plan.
branches.cn: 提议分支：失去方案的团队。

branches.en: The treaty branch: allies surprised by the news.
branches.cn: 条约分支：震惊的盟友。

branches.en: The body branch: headaches in the first days.
branches.cn: 身体分支：最初几天的头痛。

branches.en: The record branch: every withdrawal leaves a line behind.
branches.cn: 记录分支：每次撤回都会留下痕迹。

intro.en: Withdrawal is with- plus draw plus -al; the ending is the same one that turns arrive into arrival.
intro.cn: withdrawal 是 with- 加 draw 再加 -al；这个词尾与 arrive 变 arrival 所用的一致。

latinIntro.en: The ending -al came into English through French from Latin -alis; the Latin entries below show that borrowing.
latinIntro.cn: 词尾 -al 经法语从拉丁语 -alis 进入英语；下面的拉丁条目展示了这层借用。

items.example: The same prefix, a still hand.
items.exampleCN: 同一前缀，一只不动的手。

definition_zh: 在…之内；在…以内；（时间上）不超过；在内部
definition_en: inside a place, a group or a limit, or before a period of time has come to an end
core_image: 院子四周围着矮墙，墙里的地方全都算在内，墙外一步就出了界限
scene: 医生交代，这片药必须在一周之内吃完，超过了就得重来。Please reply within three days of receiving this letter.
sceneCN: 这里 within 是「在…之内、不超过」（第 1 个义项：在某范围或期限之内）；句意为请在收到此信后三天内回复。矮墙围出的那块地方，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: Inside a space or a group
senses.definition: inside the limits of a place, a group or an area
senses.definitionCN: 在某地、某群体或某区域的范围之内
senses.example: There are three small rooms within the tower.
senses.exampleCN: 塔里有三个小房间。
senses.why: The word began as with plus in, so the picture is a space with everything kept inside it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词起初是 with 加 in，画面是一个把一切都围在里面的空间。

senses.title: Before a period ends
senses.definition: before the end of a stated period of time, so the limit is never exceeded
senses.definitionCN: 在说明的这段时间结束之前，绝不超出这个限度
senses.example: Please reply within three days of receiving this letter.
senses.exampleCN: 请在收到此信后三天内回复。
senses.why: Time was treated as a space with a boundary, and staying inside it means finishing before the end.
senses.whyCN: 时间被当成一个有边界的空间，待在里面就是按时完成。

senses.title: Inside a set of rules or limits
senses.definition: inside the limits allowed by a rule, a law or an ability
senses.definitionCN: 在规则、法律或能力允许的限度之内
senses.example: The price is within the range we agreed.
senses.exampleCN: 这个价格在我们商定的范围内。
senses.why: A rule is a wall you may move inside but not cross, so the same word serves for law and ability.
senses.whyCN: 规则是一道可以活动却不能越过的墙，所以这个词也用于法律与能力。

senses.title: From inside a place
senses.definition: used after from to show a movement that starts inside something
senses.definitionCN: 用在 from 之后，表示动作从某物内部开始
senses.example: The decision was made from within the village itself.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定是从村子内部做出的。
senses.why: When the boundary is the point, the adverb can stand alone to say inside or from inside.
senses.whyCN: 当边界本身成为重点，这个副词可以单独使用，表示在里面或从里面。

intro.en: Within started as with plus in, two prepositions stacked, and became a single word meaning inside a boundary.
intro.cn: within 起初是 with 加 in，两个介词叠用，后来合为一个词，意为在边界之内。

items.en: The two words wið and inn were written together when they marked a place kept inside.
items.cn: wið 与 inn 两词在标记「围在里面」时开始连写。

items.en: The compound meant literally inside, with the inside itself as the focus.
items.cn: 这个复合词字面意为在里面，重点落在内部本身。

items.en: withinne became within, and time limits joined place limits.
items.cn: withinne 变作 within，时间界限与空间界限并列。

items.en: The word became the standard form for a limit that must not be crossed.
items.cn: 这个词成了「不得越过的界限」的标准形式。

items.en: From within and within reach fixed the word in daily phrases.
items.cn: from within 与 within reach 让这个词固定在日常短语里。

note.en: The first group holds close matches in form and meaning, the second words for limits and space.
note.cn: 第一组收形义都相近的词，第二组收表示限度与空间的词。

normal.en: It looks like with plus an n: the n of in was kept.
normal.cn: 它看起来像 with 加一个 n：in 的 n 被保留了下来。

normal.en: Without is its mirror image: both start with with.
normal.cn: without 是它的镜像：两个都以 with 开头。

normal.en: Within a week means last day included, not the day after.
normal.cn: within a week 意为最晚到那天，不含之后。

normal.en: Within reach is the arm's length as a boundary.
normal.cn: within reach 就是一条手臂长的那道边界。

abstract.cn: 一道矮墙，以及墙里聚在一起的一切。

abstract.en: A circle drawn in sand, with both feet inside it.
abstract.cn: 沙地上画的一个圈，两只脚都在圈内。

abstract.cn: 一只时针还没到刻度的钟。

examples.en: The package will arrive within four working days.
examples.cn: 包裹将在四个工作日内送达。

examples.en: The village lies within sight of the sea.
examples.cn: 村子就在能看见海的范围之内。

examples.en: We must keep our spending within the budget.
examples.cn: 我们必须把开支控制在预算之内。

sensesIntro.cn: 一个围出内部的边界变成期限，再变成规则，最后可以单独指内部本身。

branches.cn: 副词分支：从内部做出的决定。

branches.cn: 守界分支：别越过，别超支。

definition_zh: 没有；不带；不用；（后接动名词）不…就；在…之外
definition_en: not having, not using, or not accompanied by something, and in older use, outside of
core_image: 一个人出门时两只手都空着，口袋里什么也没装
scene: 他出门时两手空空，口袋里什么也没带，连钥匙都留在了桌上。We cannot finish the work without more help.
sceneCN: 这里 without 是「没有」（第 1 个义项：不带、缺少某物）；句意为没有更多人手，我们完不成这项工作。两手空着出门的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: Not having something
senses.definition: not having or not carrying something that is usually there
senses.definitionCN: 没有或未携带通常应存在之物
senses.example: We cannot finish the work without more help.
senses.exampleCN: 没有更多人手，我们完不成这项工作。
senses.why: The oldest form meant outside of, and what is outside you is simply not yours to hold.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的形式意为在…之外，而在你之外的东西就不在你手里。

senses.title: Not using something
senses.definition: not using a thing, or not doing something, as in without a key or without asking
senses.definitionCN: 不使用某物，或不做某事，如不用钥匙、不打招呼
senses.example: He opened the lock without a key.
senses.exampleCN: 他没用钥匙就把锁打开了。
senses.why: Doing something without a tool means the tool is outside the act, which is the same picture again.
senses.whyCN: 不使用工具做事，意味着工具在这一动作之外，又是同一幅画面。

senses.title: Not accompanied by
senses.definition: with no one or nothing else present, in phrases such as without a word
senses.definitionCN: 没有其他人在场或没有别的东西相伴，如 without a word
senses.example: She left the room without a word.
senses.exampleCN: 她一句话没说就离开了房间。
senses.why: A companion who is outside the scene is absent, so the preposition also marks silent or lonely action.
senses.whyCN: 不在场景里的同伴就是缺席，所以这个介词也能标记沉默或孤单的行动。

senses.title: Outside of, in older use
senses.definition: in old or literary style, on the outside of a place
senses.definitionCN: 在旧式或文学文体中，指在某地之外
senses.example: Without the city walls lay a wide empty field.
senses.exampleCN: 城墙之外是一片开阔的空地。
senses.why: This is the original sense, still alive in poetry, from which all the others grew.
senses.whyCN: 这是最原始的义项，仍活在诗歌里，其余义项都由它生长出来。

intro.en: Without began as with plus out, meaning outside, and only later slid into the modern sense of not having.
intro.cn: without 起初是 with 加 out，意为在外，后来才滑向现代「没有」的义项。

items.en: wiðutan meant outside, on the outer side of a place or a group.
items.cn: wiðutan 意为在外，处于某地或某群之外。

items.en: Being outside a group meant being denied what the group had.
items.cn: 处在群体之外，就意味着得不到群体拥有的东西。

items.en: The form became without and the lack sense came forward.
items.cn: 形式变作 without，缺少义走到了前面。

items.en: The outside sense narrowed to literary use, and the lack sense took over daily speech.
items.cn: 在外义收窄到文学用法，缺少义占领了日常言语。

items.en: Fixed phrases such as without doubt and without delay made the preposition essential.
items.cn: without doubt、without delay 这类固定短语让这个介词必不可少。

note.en: The first group collects the with family, the second other ways to say a thing is missing.
note.cn: 第一组收 with 家族，第二组收其他表示「缺失」的说法。

normalIntro.cn: without 是 with 加 out，最古老的画面就是身在某物之外，因而没有它。

normal.en: With plus out: to be out of a thing is to be without it.
normal.cn: with 加 out：在东西之外，就是没有它。

normal.en: The th is voiced, as in this; the ending out is clear.
normal.cn: th 是浊音，与 this 相同；结尾的 out 很清楚。

normal.en: The tip is flat on the upper teeth, the same shape as within.
normal.cn: 舌尖平贴上齿，与 within 一样。

normal.en: You cannot do without water: the phrase do without means manage anyway.
normal.cn: cannot do without water 意为离不开水；do without 意为将就着也行。

normal.en: Without doubt and without delay are fixed pairs worth learning as blocks.
normal.cn: without doubt 与 without delay 都是值得整块记下的固定搭配。

abstract.en: A table set for one instead of two.
abstract.cn: 一人份而非两人份的餐具。

abstract.en: A door closing on the sound of footsteps, and then silence.
abstract.cn: 门在脚步声之后关上，然后是安静。

examples.cn: 不戴眼镜她看不了书。

examples.cn: 他还没问要花多少钱就答应了。

examples.en: Without water, the garden would die in a week.
examples.cn: 没有水，这园子一周就会枯掉。

sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从身处群体之外，变成缺少某物、不使用某物、无人相伴，并在诗里保留着「在外」的旧义。

definition_zh: 目击者；证人；证词；目击；见证（某事件）
definition_en: a person who sees an event happen, and to see or to give evidence about an event
core_image: 街角的一个路人停下脚步，眼睛一直没离开那扇正在被推开的门
scene: 事故发生时，街角有个路人停下脚步，一直盯着那扇被撞开的门。The only witness to the accident was a boy of twelve.
sceneCN: 这里 witness 是「目击者」（第 1 个义项：亲眼看见某事发生的人）；句意为事故唯一的目击者是一个十二岁的男孩。街角那个停下脚步、眼睛不离开的人，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: A person who saw it
senses.definition: a person who was present and saw an event with their own eyes
senses.definitionCN: 在场并亲眼看见某事件的个人
senses.example: The only witness to the accident was a boy of twelve.
senses.exampleCN: 事故唯一的目击者是一个十二岁的男孩。
senses.why: The old noun came from a word meaning knowledge, so a witness was first simply someone who knew.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老名词来自意为「知识」的词，所以 witness 起初只是知道的人。

senses.title: A person in a court
senses.definition: someone who tells a court under oath what they saw or know
senses.definitionCN: 在法庭上宣誓讲述所见所知的人
senses.example: She appeared as a witness for the family.
senses.exampleCN: 她作为这家人的证人出庭。
senses.why: The same knowledge is now official: the witness speaks to a judge and the words become evidence.
senses.whyCN: 同样的知识成了正式的：证人向法官陈说，其话成为证据。

senses.title: To see an event happen
senses.definition: used of a person, place or time that sees an event take place
senses.definitionCN: 用于人、地点或时代看见某事件发生
senses.example: That year witnessed the biggest flood in a century.
senses.exampleCN: 那一年发生了一世纪以来最大的洪水。
senses.why: Places and years can be said to witness, so the word widens from people to the settings of events.
senses.whyCN: 地点与年份也能「见证」，于是这个词从人扩展到事件的发生场景。

senses.title: To show that something is true
senses.definition: to provide evidence of a fact, in phrases such as bear witness to
senses.definitionCN: 在 bear witness to 等说法中，为某事实提供证明
senses.example: The empty shelves bore witness to the long drought.
senses.exampleCN: 空空的货架说明旱情已久。
senses.why: If a person can tell what happened, then an object can also stand as a silent proof of it.
senses.whyCN: 如果人能讲述发生了什么，物件也能成为它的无声证明。

intro.en: Witness comes from Old English witnes, formed from witan, to know, so the witness was the one who knows what happened.
intro.cn: witness 来自古英语 witnes，由 witan（知道）构成，所以证人就是知道发生了什么的人。

items.en: witnes meant knowledge as well as a person who has it, built on witan, to know.
items.cn: witnes 既指知识，也指拥有知识的人，建于 witan（知道）之上。

items.en: The word moved towards the legal sense, a person who reports what he saw.
items.cn: 这个词转向法律义，指报告自己所见的人。

items.en: To bear witness and to call a witness fixed the noun in legal speech.
items.cn: bear witness 与 call a witness 让名词在法律语言里固定下来。

items.en: The verb came to be used of places and periods that see great events.
items.cn: 动词开始用于看见大事的地点与时期。

items.en: Silent objects, from a broken wall to an empty shelf, can now bear witness as well.
items.cn: 无声的物件，从断墙到空货架，如今也能作证。

note.en: The first group gathers same-family and look-alike words, the second other names for someone who reports events.
note.cn: 第一组收同族与形近词，第二组收其他指讲述事件者的称呼。

normalIntro.en: Witness is wit plus -ness, so the spelling keeps a single t in the middle and a single n after it.
normalIntro.cn: witness 是 wit 加 -ness，所以中间只有一个 t，后面只有一个 n。

normal.en: Wit plus ness: the one who has wit and knows what happened.
normal.cn: wit 加 ness：有见识、知道发生了什么的那个人。

normal.en: Do not double the t: it is wit, not witt, before ness.
normal.cn: t 不要写两个：加 ness 前是 wit 而非 witt。

normal.en: The plural takes -es after the s sound of ness.
normal.cn: 复数在 ness 后的 s 音后加 -es。

normal.en: An eye witness is a witness with eyes, which is all a witness ever is.
normal.cn: eye witness 意为带眼睛的证人，而证人本来就是眼睛。

normal.en: Bear witness means carry the proof, as one bears a heavy thing to court.
normal.cn: bear witness 意为把证据扛到法庭，如扛起重物。

abstract.en: Feet stopping at a corner and not moving.
abstract.cn: 在街角停住、不再移动的脚步。

abstract.en: Eyes fixed on a door as it opens.
abstract.cn: 门被推开时那双不移的眼睛。

abstract.en: A hand raised in a silent room, ready to speak.
abstract.cn: 安静的房间里举起、准备开口的手。

examples.en: Two witnesses described the same car.
examples.cn: 两名目击者描述的是同一辆车。

examples.en: We are witnessing the end of an old habit.
examples.cn: 我们正在见证一种旧习惯的终结。

examples.en: The marks on the wall bear witness to the flood.
examples.cn: 墙上的痕迹证明了那次洪水。

sensesIntro.en: The one who knows becomes the one who speaks in court, then the verb spreads to places and years, and finally to silent objects.
sensesIntro.cn: 知道的人成为在法庭上讲述的人，接着动词扩展到地点与年份，最后扩到无声的物件。
